definitions._authored: One span length is chosen here and nothing else: STROKE_SECONDS. Every other property of a stroke is read off the record.
definitions.stroke: one body's measured path over the 5.0 s before one verified release, in the shot record's own frame (tenths of a foot, hoop at origin)
definitions.vertex: a control point kept by Douglas-Peucker at 0.15 ft, carrying `dt` (frames since the previous vertex) and `arc` (tenths of a foot the body actually covered over that span, summed at the full 25 Hz before simplification). Speed is arc/dt and is therefore the true measured mean over the span, unaffected by how few control points survive
definitions.zone: index into the league's own seven SHOT_ZONE_BASIC regions, read at the vertex - a partition of the FLOOR the NBA drew, reconstructed from the geometry the plate draws and gated in qa.py against the league's own labels at 99.993%
definitions.kind: 0 = a body, 1 = the ball (the only row the feed gave a third dimension)
definitions.identity: none is shipped. No player, no game, no event, no clock - only a day index. A game, a player, or a possession's timing cannot be reconstructed from this file
